messages:
alex_customer: Hey team — running into an issue with structured output (JSON mode). Our parser throws 'Unexpected end of JSON input' intermittently when streaming responses. Happens when user messages contain emoji + long text.

maria_support: Thanks — can you paste the raw response you got? Also send request_id if available.

alex_customer: request_id=f2c9a4b7. Repro below (we're using streaming). Curl: 
```
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-encoder-1","input":"Describe the emoji: 🫠 and include a multiline string\nline2"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate | jq -R -s .
```
Raw chunk we captured (literally concatenated):
```
data: {"completion":"{\"note\":\"starts ok then a long emoji sequence 🫠🫠🫠 and a newline
and then keeps going...\"}\n"}
data: {"completion":"{\"note\":\"next chunk starts with trailing bytes: \ud83e\"}\n"}
```
Parser fails because chunk boundary splits the UTF-16 surrogate/UTF-8 multibyte sequence (\ud83e...) so the combined JSON ends up with a broken escape token.

ryan_engineer: Hmm — that looks like a streaming chunk split mid-codepoint, and our streaming layer emits literal UTF-8 bytes rather than preserving escape sequences in structured-mode. That can break downstream JSON reconstructions if client joins raw event lines and parses per-event.

maria_support: Confirming auth/billing: token worked, no 401s, and customer saw only successful 200s, so not auth. Billing: they retried a few times which increased usage — flagged for billing review but this is more of a reliability bug.

sam_sre: Can you grab the server side log around f2c9a4b7? Also indicate model and region (us-west1?).

alex_customer: Model=rwd-chat-3, region=us-west1. Server log snippet: 
```
INFO [2026-06-12T14:32:10Z] request=f2c9a4b7 stream: write 8192 bytes
INFO [2026-06-12T14:32:10Z] request=f2c9a4b7 stream: write 4096 bytes
WARN [2026-06-12T14:32:10Z] request=f2c9a4b7 stream: chunk-split mid-rune
ERROR [2026-06-12T14:32:10Z] request=f2c9a4b7: client parse error downstream: json: unexpected end of JSON input
```
ryan_engineer: I can repro locally with a tiny harness: purposely craft response that contains a 4-byte emoji where we split the buffer. Our streamer currently slices bytes not runes before applying any JSON escaping in structured-mode. Fix candidate: ensure structured-mode serializes strings with escaped non-ASCII (\u...) OR atomically avoid splitting multi-byte UTF-8 sequences across chunks.

maria_support: Short-term workaround for the customer: switch to poll/non-streaming mode (Accept: application/json) or post-process stream by joining and reassembling partial escape sequences before JSON.parse. We should provide a small client snippet.

ryan_engineer: Suggested patch in PR #5123 — will add unit test for streaming emoji boundaries and an escaping pass that converts problematic runes to \uXXXX escapes when streaming structured output. If we can't finish today, I'll flip a rollout gate to keep structured-mode non-streaming for models with known multibyte-heavy outputs.

sam_sre: Also add rate-limit guard so repeated retries don't trigger a billing spike; set temporal 429 backoff guidance in support KB.

alex_customer: Appreciate quick response. We'll try non-streaming for now. Please keep me posted on the patch/ETA.

maria_support: Noted — tracking internally under INC-2026-119. Assigning to ryan_engineer for fix + regression tests. Will update once deployed. :thumbsup:
